page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.12xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance within the High Clock Speed family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 48 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz. Hardware allocation includes 384.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance operates without integrated local storage or hardware accelerators, requiring external network-attached volumes for persistent data storage.

Network performance is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput node communication and external data access. Because the platform delivers a substantial 1:8 core-to-memory allocation alongside a 3.4 GHz clock speed, it offers balanced scaling for processes demanding both rapid execution cycles and extensive memory tables. However, operational architectures must account for latency over network storage, as zero local disk capacity is bundled directly with the hardware.

The hardware configuration makes the ecs.hfr9i.12xlarge suited for demanding enterprise workloads including in-memory relational and non-relational database systems, large-scale enterprise resource planning installations, memory-bound data analysis, and multi-threaded batch compute services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.12xlarge is a high clock speed, memory-dense cloud instance featuring 48 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.4 GHz. It provides 384.0 GB of RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB per core allocation profile, backed by a 25 Gbps baseline network capacity. The virtual server does not include local disk storage or GPU accelerators, necessitating network-attached storage for operating system and data requirements. With elevated processing frequencies and a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory footprint, ecs.hfr9i.12xlarge is optimized for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, in-memory databases, real-time analytics, and compute-heavy caching engines.
